title: AdversarialReviewFinding
description: One finding emitted by a reviewer persona. Reviewers output a JSON array of these.

id.description: Stable id, e.g. '<lens>-001'. Optional on emit; the arbiter assigns if absent.

lens.description: The reviewer lens that raised it.

confidence.description: How sure the reviewer is the finding is real (not the severity).

location.description: path/to/file.ext:line, or a range, or 'plan' for plan-gate findings.

target_ref.description: Stacked reviews only: which branch or commit in the stack the fix belongs in (may differ from where the finding surfaced). null for single-change reviews.

claim.description: What is wrong and why, concretely.

evidence.description: Concrete evidence, e.g. 'ran `npm test`, got FAILED: ...'. null if opinion-only; null + low confidence is auto-downweighted by the arbiter.

suggested_fix.description: The concrete change the reviewer proposes.

blast_radius.description: True if this touches data loss, irreversible migration, security/privacy, or auth. Always escalates regardless of severity.

verdict.description: Set by the arbiter/author during triage, not by the reviewer.

resolution_route.description: Plan ARL only: whether an accepted finding can be resolved directly in the spec ('auto-fix') or requires user clarification via /grill-me ('grill-me').
